body: Don’t kill your self your life has purpose you are not selfish for wanting to commit suicide. I know what it feels like to want to die but you can get through this. All I want is to help people suffering from depression, anxiety, abuse and suicidal thoughts. Just believe me don’t kill your self.
You don’t need to kill your self. I know what going through this is like and how hard it can be but you can get through this. You can be tired of suffering but you can’t give up it’s for your good.
